sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    P=O=None; C=[]; B=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color']=='N': P=(r0,c0)
        elif n['color']=='O': O=(r0,c0)
        elif n['color'] in ('c','G','B') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['pixels']<=16: C.append((r0,c0,n['color'],n['pixels']))
        elif n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<=8: B.append((r0,c0))
    return P,O,sorted(C),sorted(B)
for a in ['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT']:
    r=action([a],intent='explore')
    print(a,snap(current_frame),"noimp",r.get('no_impact'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(f):
    P=O=None; C=[]; B=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color']=='N': P=(r0,c0)
        elif n['color']=='O': O=(r0,c0)
        elif n['color'] in ('c','G','B') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['pixels']<=16: C.append((r0,c0,n['color'],n['pixels']))
        elif n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<=8: B.append((r0,c0))
    return P,O,sorted(C),sorted(B)
for a in ['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT']:
    r=action([a],intent='explore')
    print(a,snap(current_frame),"noimp",r.get('no_impact'))
